note_cn: 基于过去 60 个交易日的日对数收益,计算 7 只成分股两两皮尔逊相关系数。下面的曲线是过去 5 年里这个矩阵的平均非对角相关系数——越接近 1,这七只越像「一笔交易」。
note_en: Pairwise Pearson correlation of daily log returns over the trailing 60 trading days. The lower curve shows the average off-diagonal correlation over the last 5 years — closer to 1 means the seven names trade more and more like a single position.
